Sparkling Tones for desktop, part five: generate with AI.
Click "Generate with AI" and describe the sound you're after, in your own words.
Copy the request, and paste it into the AI chat you already use. No account or key needed here.
Paste the reply back into the app, and the new preset goes on stage, ready to play.
Sparkling Tones: free, for Windows and in your browser. Thanks for watching.
